title: Pickup your custom eggless cake before work — Riverstone opens at 6am
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not a typo — it's for the Marsden Park and Schofields families picking up a custom eggless cake before a shift starts, not after it.

Every cake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake, since 2019. Six sizes, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Ferrero Rocher, any design from a photo reference. Buttercream, fondant, or ganache.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking at the shopping centre — no city traffic before your shift.

WhatsApp +61 425 697 725 to lock in a pickup time.
